headline.CODE: chart-yy, chart-level — selects the general CPI (120010)
headline.NAME_HE: skip: one code; the page uses its own short label
headline.DATE: chart-yy, chart-recent, chart-heat, chart-annual, chart-level, insight:ytd
headline.VALUE: kpi:level — the published level on the current base
headline.BASE_DESC: kpi:level — the base named in the KPI label and the lede
headline.PERCENT_YEAR: chart-yy, chart-annual, chart-excluding, kpi:yy, insight:target, insight:band_years
headline.VALUE_CHAINED: chart-level, chart-rebased, kpi:ytd, insight:ytd, insight:longrun, insight:since_start
headline.CHAIN_BASE: chart-level — the base named in the long-run note
groups.CODE: chart-groups, chart-rebased, chart-excluding — selects excluding indices vs main groups
groups.NAME_HE: chart-groups, chart-excluding — label fallback for codes without a short label
groups.VALUE: chart-groups — index level column of the groups table
groups.BASE_DESC: skip: read but not shown (levels on the current base, same as the headline's)
groups.PERCENT: chart-groups — monthly change column of the groups table
groups.PERCENT_YEAR: chart-groups, chart-excluding, kpi:core, insight:groups, insight:housing, insight:core
groups.CHAIN_BASE: skip: read but not shown (the rebased chart sets its own start = 100)
secondary.NAME_HE: chart-secondary — label (shortened for a few long CBS names)
secondary.DATE: chart-secondary — read at the headline's latest month
secondary.VALUE: skip: levels of secondary groups are not shown
secondary.BASE_DESC: skip: levels of secondary groups are not shown
secondary.PERCENT: chart-secondary — monthly change column of the table
secondary.VALUE_CHAINED: skip: secondary groups are compared by published y/y only
secondary.CHAIN_BASE: skip: secondary groups are compared by published y/y only
